scripts.perf:regression: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='automation/reports/lighthouse-production-latest.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('perf:regression: no lighthouse report found, skipping (non-blocking)');process.exit(0)}const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const perf=(r.categories&&r.categories.performance&&r.categories.performance.score)||0;console.log('perf:regression: performance score',perf);if(perf<0.4){console.error('Performance regression: score below 0.4 threshold');process.exit(1)}console.log('perf:regression ok')"
